corpusClasses: C1 = every committed .swf plus the fuzz crashers; C1-fuzz = the crasher corpus; C4-c = the licensed external movies (--with-open only). C3, the reference title, is OPEN in registers/corpus.md §2, so §10.1 is not measurable by this lane.
exitCodePolicy: CMP-R029: 0 ok, 1 error-severity diagnostics, 2 unreadable or bad usage, 3 AVM2 (SF1000), 4 threshold, 5 internal bug. An input may legitimately exit 1, 2 or 3; only 5 fails this lane, with drift between runs that must agree and an unclean verify on a project that reported no errors.
protocol: plan, inspect, a cold build in a fresh workspace, the same build again on a warm cache, the same build in a second workspace, then verify and verify --deep --against on what the first workspace wrote
syntheticSet: C2 is the movies the fixture writers build in-process, and `IMPL-120` §10.3 counts them in "the whole corpus". They are round-tripped by the test lane — `packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts` (its four builders) and `packages/compile/test/verify.test.ts` (a sprite-and-action movie, emitted and verified) — not by this script, because the writers live in `test/support/` and no built module exports them. `registers/corpus.md` open item 4 (C2 is not enumerated as an artifact) is the register's to close.
